extraction.title: Warsh and peace
extraction.subtitle: How Kevin Warsh could save the Federal Reserve There is much to like about the next Fed chairman—if his backbone holds
extraction.summary: Kevin Warsh is poised to become the next chairman of the Federal Reserve following the withdrawal of a criminal investigation into Jerome Powell. His ability to maintain the Fed's independence amidst political pressure from President Trump will be crucial, especially in light of rising inflation and oil prices. Warsh's proposed reforms include reducing the Fed's balance sheet and focusing on a broader range of data.
